K6 is MISSING because there is no mention of framework-driven development strategy, reusable codebases, or retrofitting features across titles, which are core components of this criterion. The overall coverage is strong for financial performance, guidance, and liquidity, but the absence of strategic development framework details prevents a perfect score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected, with consistent progression from overall performance to specific drivers, financial metrics, and outlook. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues. Explanations for margin changes (S5-S6) are clear and consistent. The summary maintains a logical flow from revenue growth (S1-S4) to segment performance (S7-S12), monetisation improvements (S13-S15), cost structure (S16-S17), quarterly performance (S18-S19), cash flow (S20-S21), balance sheet (S22), and outlook (S23). While there is some repetition regarding the Transport Series' importance (S1, S7), this does not materially reduce clarity and serves to reinforce the main growth driver.
